chinese: 天地所以能长且久者，以其不自生，故能长生。
是以圣人后其身而身先；
非以其无私邪，故能成其私。
pinyin: Tiān dì suǒ yǐ néng zhǎng qiě jiǔ zhě， yǐ qí bù zì shēng， gù néng zhǎng shēng。
Shì yǐ shèng rén hòu qí shēn ér shēn xiān；
Wài qí shēn ér shēn cún。
Fēi yǐ qí wú sī xié， gù néng chéng qí sī。
english: The Tao of Heaven is eternal, and the earth is long enduring. Why are they long enduring? They do not live for themselves; thus they are present for all beings.

The Master puts herself last; And finds herself in the place of authority. She detaches herself from all things; Therefore she is united with all things. She gives no thought to self. She is perfectly fulfilled.
